subject: Coordination: cross-border backup purge pause and restore escrow — action plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@healthsync.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate request: pause backup purge for pending audit + escrow options

Markus / Kimberly,

We just received a last-minute regulatory audit notice for one of our EU customers (case ref: EU-AUD-221). Auditor has requested evidence that certain transaction logs and backups will be preserved for the next 45 days while they complete a targeted review. Our legal team is asking Redwood to pause the scheduled purge for the affected retention bucket and to confirm an escrow/restore path if needed.

Questions we have right now:
- Can you confirm whether a short-term hold (45 days) can be applied to the backup set without impacting the broader purge cadence?
- What is the process to place a temporary escrow hold and what data would be included in the escrow snapshot?
- Are there cross-border transfer implications we should be aware of if the escrow provider stores snapshots outside the EU?

We need a quick plan and an owner so we can scope a request to our compliance team.

Thanks,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Security & Compliance
HealthSync Inc.

Attachment: none (initial ask)
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate request: pause backup purge for pending audit + escrow options

Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up. We can support a 45-day hold and an escrow snapshot; proposing the following immediate steps:

1) Technical pause: implement a targeted purge pause for the affected retention bucket (non-destructive) — target window: 45 days. Owner: Kimberly.
2) Escrow snapshot: create a point-in-time snapshot of the backups and logs required by auditors and transfer to an escrow provider (Jonas at EscrowCorp recommended). Data scope to include: transaction logs (T-logs), user metadata, and the last 90 days of backups for that bucket. Owner: Laura (legal) + Markus (ops liaison).
3) Data residency check: confirm escrow provider's storage location(s) and whether EU-only storage can be guaranteed for the snapshot. If not possible, we will require a DTA/adequate safeguards.
4) Communication & timeline: we will aim to complete snapshot + escrow transfer within 72 hours of approval.

I've looped in Laura for contract/redline and Kimberly for the technical runbook. Draft runbook attached (PurgePause_TechnicalRunbook.pdf) — contains CLI steps, monitoring playbook, and rollback/restore instructions.

Can you confirm the list of specific object prefixes / retention bucket IDs and the names of any subprocessor contacts that must be notified?

—Markus
VP, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PurgePause_TechnicalRunbook.pdf (outline of steps; ~6 pages)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate request: pause backup purge for pending audit + escrow options

Markus / Alyssa —

Technical notes after a quick infrastructure review:
- We can add an indexed hold at the bucket prefix level without a full system-wide purge freeze. That will prevent the GC job from tombstoning objects for 45 days.
- Escrow snapshot: we'll produce a compressed, verifiable snapshot (SHA256 checksums per object) and deliver to the escrow endpoint. The snapshot will include logs and metadata; PII fields remain redacted unless HealthSync explicitly requests full payloads in writing.
- Estimated work: 6 engineer-hours for snapshot/transfer + 2 hours for validation and checksums.
- Rollback risk: minimal, but if the bucket has immutability policies from upstream subprocessors, we need confirmation.

I will need the exact bucket IDs (e.g., hs-prod-logs-{region}-2025) and any subprocessor list. Alyssa, can you share those?

I'll stand up the snapshot job once I have sign-off.

—Kimberly
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: PurgePause_TechnicalRunbook.pdf
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@healthsync.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate request: pause backup purge for pending audit + escrow options

Thanks — bucket IDs below and a couple clarifications.

Affected prefixes:
- hs-prod-transactions-eu/2025/*
- hs-prod-auditlogs-eu/2025/*

We will request full payloads for the auditors (they are operating under a lawful basis and we will produce DPA-covered evidence). If storing outside the EU is unavoidable, we need your confirmation of safeguards (SCCs or equivalence).

Escrow provider: Jonas at EscrowCorp is fine; his team supports EU-only storage locations. Please connect with him for SFTP endpoint and transfer ACLs. cc: devops-support@healthsync.com for transfer coordination.

Alyssa

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Lindström <jonas@escrowcorp.global>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Escrow agreement draft and signature request (HealthSync / Redwood)

Jonas / Alyssa —

Attached is Escrow_Agreement_Draft_v3.docx with the redlines we discussed. Key items:
- Scope: explicit list of buckets/prefixes + SHA256 manifest requirement.
- Residency: escrow storage restricted to EU regions (Frankfurt or Dublin) — EscrowCorp confirms availability.
- Retention and access: snapshot held for 45 days; release to HealthSync only upon written auditor request.
- Subprocessor notification: Redwood will notify the following subprocessors involved in the snapshot transfer: CloudStore GmbH (EU storage), CDNOps Ltd.
- Cost & timing: fee schedule appended. Redwood will cover initial transfer cost for this one-off audit event.

Please sign via DocuSign (link below) so we can trigger the snapshot.
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/healthsync/escrow/HS-3421

Laura Bennett (she/her)
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Escrow_Agreement_Draft_v3.docx
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escrow agreement draft and signature request (HealthSync / Redwood)

All —

Confirmed: DocuSign link validated, escrow provider EU-only storage confirmed by Jonas. Kimberly to schedule the snapshot job tomorrow morning (start window 0400-0600 UTC to minimize impact). Laura — once signed, please notify finance for cost coding (we're covering transfer for this audit).

I've created the internal incident ticket: RDW-INC-5872 and added runbook pointers. I'll monitor transfer and set a follow-up check-in at +24h.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

—Markus
VP, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Inline references: Incident RDW-INC-5872; PurgePause_TechnicalRunbook.pdf; DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/healthsync/escrow/HS-3421
